Name: Tanks.V.S
Overview: Take control of a tank in a classic-style arcade shooter with a few new tricks. Use the scenery to rebound your shots into the other tanks. Play a variety of game types and backdrops with up to three friends or have the computer stand in. Features include: one to four players; substitute AI with three difficulties; five game modes; two backdrops; dedicated widescreen and 4:3 layouts.
